question: Arvana Pharma Ltd: PO unit price ₹1,200 for 1000 units; the invoice charges ₹1,218 per unit. Can the line pass the price match?
gold: No — raise PRICE_VAR. Excess ₹18,000 on a line value of ₹1,200,000; limit is the lower of 1% (₹12,000) and ₹500 = ₹500.
answer_text:
Status: answered
Decision: Hold the line — price variance above tolerance
Answer: The line cannot pass the price match because the excess of ₹18,000 exceeds the tolerance limit of ₹500. [1][2][3]
  PO line value (₹1,200 × 1000): ₹12,00,000
  Excess on line (₹18 × 1000): ₹18,000
  1% of PO line value: ₹12,000
  Cap: ₹500
  Limit (lower of the two): ₹500
  Excess within limit?: No
Exception code: PRICE_VAR
